answer_1.quote: We evaluate three representative baselines... hypotheses are generated to capture patterns specific to the positive class.

answer_2.quote: LLM-based evaluation incorporates both scoring and pairwise comparison assessments. For scoring, LLMs assign a rating on a 5-point scale to reflect each hypothesis's quality.

answer_3.quote: We perform LLM-based evaluation... LLMs assign a rating on a 5-point scale... and we randomly pair hypotheses and prompt the LLMs to select the better hypothesis in each pair.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to assess the quality of the generated hypotheses... A total of nine participants are recruited... using a pairwise comparison format, allowing experts to select the higher-quality hypothesis or indicate if the difference is difficult to discern.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to select the higher-quality hypothesis or indicate if the difference was hard to tell.
